variables.name: deco/marker
variables.description: Shows the 6px location marker in Tabs, Nav item and Navigation menu. Utility only.

variables.name: font/eyebrow
variables.description: Eyebrow family per Studio flavor: Utility uses its mono (Fragment Mono); other flavors follow font/label.

variables.name: icon/stroke
variables.description: Icon stroke width. Utility 1.5px (fine, Swiss print); other flavors 2px (unchanged).

variables.name: input/l/border
variables.description: Utility: gray 9 — lightest gray ≥3:1 on white. Other flavors: gray 10 (current border/input).

variables.name: radius/checkbox
variables.description: Checkbox corner radius per Studio flavor (Utility 2, other flavors 4). Theme radius/checkbox follows it in Theme Studio.

variables.name: ring/d
variables.description: Focus ring (dark). Atelier: gray d/10. Others: Base accent accent/d/ring (unchanged).

variables.name: ring/l
variables.description: Focus ring (light). Atelier: ink (gray 12) — round-6 accepted gray/ink ring. Others: Base accent accent/l/11 (unchanged).

variables.name: signal/l/brand
variables.description: Utility logo/brand (aliases brand/l). Swiss red only on the N mark.

variables.name: signal/l/marker
variables.description: Utility: ink (gray 12). Location marker square + selected-row bar + link hover underline. Other flavors: their primary.

variables.name: signal/l/underline
variables.description: Utility: gray 8 resting link underline. Other flavors: primary/text.

variables.name: type/eyebrow/style
variables.description: Eyebrow font style per Studio flavor, paired with font/eyebrow. Utility is Regular because Fragment Mono has no Medium face; other flavors follow type/label/style.

variables.name: type/mono-strong/style
variables.description: Strong weight of font/mono per Studio flavor (current breadcrumb, mono emphasis). Follows type/strong/style where the mono family has that face; Utility Regular (Fragment Mono has no Medium), Workshop Bold (Space Mono has no SemiBold), Playful Medium (DM Mono has no SemiBold).
